name: 77051 · Houston, TX
findings: ZIP 77051 (Houston) has 103 nonprofit organizations. 34 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 24 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (58% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77051 (Houston) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
